name: Alleged bulk downloads at unnamed restaurant and apparel companies

attribution.legal_posture: Official federal indictment; download and apparent-exfiltration conduct remain allegations, with data and impact unspecified

caveats: Behavioral signals require corroboration and human review; staffing, badge, device, download, location, and sector signals become DPRK attribution only with supporting evidence.
Official federal indictment; download and apparent-exfiltration conduct remain allegations, with data and impact unspecified.

statements: The indictment alleges that a worker at an unnamed restaurant chain accessed sensitive server segments and downloaded large amounts of information during a short tenure. It separately alleges what appeared to be repeated data exfiltration at an unnamed apparel company, without identifying the data, downstream use, or confirmed impact.
defensive_controls: Apply download-volume and unusual-egress monitoring from the first day of contractor access.
Investigate abrupt leave/non-return combined with bulk access, but do not treat leave alone as malicious.
Use country/IP anomalies only as corroborating evidence; VPNs, travel and third-party infrastructure can make geolocation misleading.
